_doc: Platform-independent integrity for the golden set. The committed candidates.jsonl is text-free; full text is rebuilt locally by scripts/materialize_text.py. File hashes here are over LF bytes. manifest.json's candidates_sha256 was computed on a Windows CRLF working copy at sampling time and is kept unchanged as history.

v1.rationales: Pre-annotator rationales are stored as rationale_sha256 in suggestions.jsonl and in each annotation's model_suggestion; materialize_text.py --golden rebuilds both files from the local pre-annotator response cache and checks these original hashes.
